relationships.subject: Mechanical acupuncture at ST36
relationships.evidence_quote: MAI treatment significantly suppressed carrageenan-induced upregulation of TRPV1 and pNR2B expression in the spinal dorsal horn (p < 0.05)

relationships.subject: Mechanical acupuncture at ST36
relationships.evidence_quote: MAI-treated animals showed an anti-hyperalgesic effect at 2 and 4 h compared to animals with carrageenan-treated inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsazepine-treated animals (CZP + CR) showed significantly reduced carrageenan-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia 1 and 2 h after carrageenan injection compared to animals with carrageenan-treated inflammatory pain (p < 0.01).

relationships.subject: carrageenan
relationships.evidence_quote: Following injection, TRPV1 and pNR2B expression levels in the spinal dorsal horn were significantly elevated relative to those in normal controls

relationships.subject: Mechanical acupuncture at ST36
relationships.evidence_quote: MAI treatment at ST36 suppressed carrageenan-enhanced Iba1 (microglia marker) expression (p < 0.05)

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Wang et al. reported that increased TRPV1 activity facilitates the release of neuropeptides—including substance P and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)

key_findings: Mechanical acupuncture at ST36 (60-180 s) reduced capsaicin-induced licking and carrageenan allodynia/hyperalgesia in mice.
MAI and capsazepine suppressed carrageenan-induced spinal TRPV1 and Iba1 upregulation; causality not established.
